_notes: Floor plan: storefront on left (Existing Glass + BACKLIT door); SKINCARE wall on top (EB / TFS / GV / DermDoc / Minimalist / Aqualogica / Pilgrim / D&K); MAKEUP wall on bottom (Maybelline / Faces / Lakme / Swiss+ / Mars+Nybae / Alps / Loreal / Beauty); F.O.H in centre with Nail Unit + Fragrance Mini Bar + 2 Makeup vanity units; CASH COUNTER on right with ACCESSORIES + LED Panel; Access door to back-room on bottom-right.

Camera mapping (verified from mid-frame inspection of each clip, 10-Apr-2026 ~20:11 IST, 1920x1080): CAM 1 = skincare wall + F.O.H makeup vanity; CAM 2 = makeup wall + nail/fragrance unit; CAM 3 = front-door entry; CAM 4 = back-of-house staff/storage room; CAM 5 = cash counter / billing.
Polygons are NORMALISED image coordinates [0..1] (x then y). The pipeline tests the foot-point ((x1+x2)/2, y2) of each track for membership.
CAM_BACKROOM_04 is staff-only: any visitor seen there is forced is_staff=true (high-precision staff signal that backs up the CLIP zero-shot classifier).

CAM_ENTRY_03.description: Front door (BACKLIT + Existing Glass storefront). User-supplied entry-gate quadrilateral (1920x1080 px): A(920,861) B(1152,510) C(1042,434) D(812,719). Long sides AB & CD are the door jambs; short sides DA (inside) and BC (outside) define the threshold. Crossing line goes mid(DA)->mid(BC); inbound is toward mid(DA) (down-and-left in image).

CAM_SKINCARE_01.description: Camera at upper-right corner of store. SKINCARE wall floor strip and right-foreground F.O.H makeup vanity area provided by user image-map (1920x1080). SKINCARE wall split into 8 brand bands from far (EB) to near (D&K).

CAM_MAKEUP_02.description: Camera at lower-left corner of store. MAKEUP wall floor strip provided by user image-map (1920x1080), split into 8 brand bands from far (Beauty) to near (Maybelline). Left-side floor strip = FRAGRANCE_NAIL. Aggregate fallback zones MAKEUP_WALL and NAILS_AREA cover the same regions (matched only if no specific brand band hits).

CAM_BACKROOM_04.description: Back-of-house storage / staff area (purplle inventory cartons, water dispenser, staff backpacks, stool). Not customer-facing — anyone present is staff.

CAM_BILLING_05.description: Cash counter mid-frame (white desk + POS laptop). HAIRCARE shelf on left wall; ACCESSORIES backlit display on right wall; back-room access door at top-centre. BILLING polygon (customer side floor in front of the cash counter) provided by user image-map (1920x1080).
